title: Tidings For The Season
description: A serious TV newscaster's life changes when he meets his young superfan and the boy's hardworking single mum, but a career opportunity forces him to choose between ambition and love.

title: The More The Merrier
description: Alice, an ER doctor, volunteers to work Christmas Eve. During a snowy Christmas, Alice and Brian, a top-rated cardiologist, help deliver three baby booms, sparking a lasting bond.

title: A Novel Noel
description: A book editor takes on a temporary gig running a bookstore, where her battles with the owner's son allow her to rediscover her passion for nurturing creativity.

title: Holiday Unplugged
description: A screen-free Christmas helps Sally reconnect with her family and find new love, as they learn to cherish old memories and make new ones.

title: Christmas On Call
description: The lives of various first responders in Philadelphia intersect over the holiday season while juggling work, personal lives and their dedication to protect and serve their city.

title: Holiday Touchdown: A Bills Love Story
description: Sparks fly between two lifelong Buffalo Bills fans as they try to discover the identity of a mysterious Christmas gift-giver.

title: Hanukkah on the Rocks
description: An lawyer embarks on a journey to find Hanukkah candles, leading her to a Chicago bar where she transforms the holiday spirit and finds the courage to pursue a new path.

title: To Have And To Holiday
description: Celeste and Jason get engaged and ask her pastor father - who's not ready to let his daughter go - to officiate their Christmas wedding.

title: An Ice Palace Romance
description: After a journalist returns to her hometown ice rink to cover a story, the rink's owner melts her heart.

title: A Christmas Less Travelled
description: An old audio cassette of her dad's voice sends a woman on a journey to retrace her family's most memorable moments at Christmastime.

title: Deck The Walls
description: Interior designer, Rose DeMonte, uses her skills back in her hometown to renovate a Christmas Charity Home for her brother Sal and his contractor Brysen's home flipping company.

title: A Royal Montana Christmas
description: Princess Victoria is ready for a change of pace. Looking to decompress, she decides to take a vacation to Peaceful Pines Ranch in Montana.

title: A Very Vermont Christmas
description: A local champion skier and Vermont brew master teams up with an unlikely match to create a seasonal microbrew to save her family's business before Christmas.

title: Season's Greetings From...
description: Across three different eras, different families occupy a family home, leaving their own festive mark throughout the years despite life's challenges.

title: Sugarplummed
description: When Emily wishes for a perfect Christmas like the ones found in the popular Sugarplum movies, she's shocked when Sugarplum herself appears to help her fulfil it.

title: She's Making A List
description: A naughty-or-nice inspector falls for a widowed father while evaluating his daughter, forcing her to choose between duty and love.

title: Everything Christmas
description: Christmas enthusiast Lori-Jo embarks on an epic three-day road trip with her workaholic best friend to the town where it's Christmas all year round.

title: A Make Or Break Holiday
description: A couple hosting Christmas decides to fake their relationship after choosing to separate. Working together for the holiday helps them remember why they fell in love.

title: The Christmas Quest
description: When an archaeologist begins a search for an ancient Christmas treasure, she must team up with her ex-husband - who is an expert in Nordic languages - to find it.

title: Magic In Mistletoe
description: After best-selling author Harrington's social media comments ruffle feathers, publicist April's damage control plan means spending Christmas together.
